name: raindrop
label: Raindrop
description: Bookmark manager to save, search, and organize content from the web

create_raindrop.label: Create Bookmark
create_raindrop.description: Saves a new bookmark to your Raindrop.io account

link.label: URL
link.description: The URL of the page to bookmark

title.label: Title
title.description: Custom title for the bookmark. If left empty, Raindrop will extract it from the URL automatically.

excerpt.label: Excerpt
excerpt.description: Short description or summary of the page

note.label: Note
note.description: Personal note to attach to this bookmark

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: List of tags to organize the bookmark (press Enter to add each tag)

important.label: Mark as Favourite
important.description: Mark this bookmark as important / favourite

get_raindrop.label: Get Bookmark
get_raindrop.description: Retrieves the details of a bookmark by its ID

raindrop_id.label: Bookmark ID
raindrop_id.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).

update_raindrop.label: Update Bookmark
update_raindrop.description: Updates the details of an existing bookmark

raindrop_id.label: Bookmark ID
raindrop_id.description: The numeric ID of the bookmark to update. You can find it in the URL when viewing the bookmark in Raindrop.io (e.g. raindrop.io/app/raindrop/123456789).

excerpt.label: New Excerpt
excerpt.description: Updated short description or summary of the page

note.label: New Note
note.description: Updated personal note attached to the bookmark

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: New list of tags (replaces existing tags). Leave empty to keep existing tags unchanged.

important.label: Mark as Favourite
important.description: Mark or unmark this bookmark as important / favourite

find_raindrops.label: Find Bookmarks
find_raindrops.description: Lists bookmarks from a collection, with optional keyword search

collection_id.label: Collection
collection_id.description: Select the collection to use. Leave empty to use "Unsorted" (default inbox).

search.label: Search Query
search.description: Filter bookmarks by keyword. Supports operators like #tag or type:article. Leave empty to list all bookmarks.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of bookmarks to return (max 50)

raindrop_create_backup.label: Create Backup
raindrop_create_backup.description: Starts generating a new backup of all bookmarks.

raindrop_list_backups.label: List Backups
raindrop_list_backups.description: Lists the account backups, newest first.

raindrop_create_bookmark.label: Create Bookmark
raindrop_create_bookmark.description: Saves a new bookmark (raindrop) from a URL.

title.label: Title
title.description: Bookmark title. Parsed from the page when omitted.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID to save into, from List Collections. Defaults to Unsorted (-1).

important.label: Favourite
important.description: Mark the bookmark as a favourite.

raindrop_delete_bookmark.label: Delete Bookmark
raindrop_delete_bookmark.description: Moves a bookmark to Trash, or deletes it permanently if already in Trash.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.

raindrop_delete_bookmarks.label: Delete Bookmarks
raindrop_delete_bookmarks.description: Moves many bookmarks in a collection to Trash at once.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID holding the bookmarks, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash (permanent delete); 0 = all collections except Trash.

ids.label: Bookmark IDs
ids.description: Only delete these bookmark IDs, from List Bookmarks.

allBookmarks.label: All Bookmarks
allBookmarks.description: Set to true to delete every bookmark in the collection. Required when neither Bookmark IDs nor Search is set.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only delete bookmarks matching this Raindrop search query, e.g. "#old".

raindrop_get_bookmark.label: Get Bookmark
raindrop_get_bookmark.description: Gets a single bookmark by its ID.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.

raindrop_list_bookmarks.label: List Bookmarks
raindrop_list_bookmarks.description: Lists bookmarks in a collection, with optional search and sort.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. Defaults to 0 (all bookmarks except Trash); -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.

search.label: Search
search.description: Raindrop search query, the same text that works in the Raindrop app search box, e.g. "#ai type:article".

sort.label: Sort
sort.description: Sort order. Defaults to newest first (-created).

perpage.label: Per Page
perpage.description: Bookmarks per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.

nested.label: Include Nested Collections
nested.description: Yes also includes bookmarks from child collections. Defaults to No.

raindrop_update_bookmark.label: Update Bookmark
raindrop_update_bookmark.description: Updates the fields you set on an existing bookmark.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.

excerpt.label: Excerpt
excerpt.description: New short description of the page.

cover.label: Cover URL
cover.description: New cover image URL. Use Upload Bookmark Cover to upload an image file instead.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID to move the bookmark into, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag names that replace the current tags, e.g. ["reading", "ai"].

clearTags.label: Clear Tags
clearTags.description: Remove all tags from the bookmark. Cannot be combined with Tags.

important.label: Favourite
important.description: Mark or unmark the bookmark as a favourite.

order.label: Order
order.description: Sort position in its collection, ascending; 0 moves it to the top.

pleaseParse.label: Re-parse Metadata
pleaseParse.description: Re-read cover, type and content from the URL in the background.

raindrop_update_bookmarks.label: Update Bookmarks
raindrop_update_bookmarks.description: Updates many bookmarks in a collection at once.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID holding the bookmarks, from List Collections. -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash; 0 = all collections except Trash.

ids.label: Bookmark IDs
ids.description: Only update these bookmark IDs, from List Bookmarks.

allBookmarks.label: All Bookmarks
allBookmarks.description: Set to true to update every bookmark in the collection. Required when neither Bookmark IDs nor Search is set.

search.label: Search
search.description: Only update bookmarks matching this Raindrop search query, e.g. "#ai".

important.label: Favourite
important.description: Mark or unmark the bookmarks as favourites.

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tag names to add to the bookmarks, e.g. ["reading"]. Existing tags are kept.

clearTags.label: Clear Tags
clearTags.description: Remove all tags from the bookmarks. Cannot be combined with Tags.

cover.label: Cover URL
cover.description: Cover image URL to set, or "<screenshot>" to use a page screenshot.

targetCollectionId.label: Move to Collection ID
targetCollectionId.description: Collection ID to move the bookmarks into, from List Collections.

parentId.label: Parent Collection ID
parentId.description: ID of the parent collection, from List Collections or List Child Collections. Omit to create a root collection.

cover.label: Cover URLs
cover.description: Cover image URLs, e.g. one from Search Covers or List Featured Covers.

raindrop_delete_collection.label: Delete Collection
raindrop_delete_collection.description: Deletes a collection and all its sub-collections.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.

raindrop_delete_empty_collections.label: Delete Empty Collections
raindrop_delete_empty_collections.description: Deletes every collection that has no bookmarks.

raindrop_empty_trash.label: Empty Trash
raindrop_empty_trash.description: Permanently deletes every bookmark in Trash.

raindrop_get_collection_counts.label: Get Collection Counts
raindrop_get_collection_counts.description: Gets bookmark counts for the system collections (All, Unsorted, Trash).

raindrop_get_collection.label: Get Collection
raindrop_get_collection.description: Gets a single collection by ID.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.

raindrop_list_featured_covers.label: List Featured Covers
raindrop_list_featured_covers.description: Lists the featured cover icon sets.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Numeric collection ID from List Collections or List Child Collections. System collections: 0 = all bookmarks, -1 = Unsorted, -99 = Trash.

parentId.label: Parent Collection ID
parentId.description: ID of the new parent collection, from List Collections or List Child Collections.

public.label: Public
public.description: Make the collection and its bookmarks accessible without authentication.

view.label: View
view.description: How bookmarks in the collection are displayed.

cover.label: Cover URLs
cover.description: Cover image URLs, e.g. one from Search Covers or List Featured Covers. Replaces the current cover.

clearCover.label: Clear Cover
clearCover.description: Yes removes the current cover. Cannot be combined with Cover URLs.

moveToRoot.label: Move to Root
moveToRoot.description: Yes makes the collection a root collection. Cannot be combined with Parent Collection ID.

raindrop_add_highlight.label: Add Highlight
raindrop_add_highlight.description: Adds a highlighted quote to a bookmark.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: Numeric bookmark ID, e.g. "123456789". Use List Bookmarks or Create Bookmark to get it.

raindrop_delete_highlight.label: Delete Highlight
raindrop_delete_highlight.description: Removes a highlight from a bookmark.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: ID of the bookmark the highlight is on: raindropRef from List Highlights.

raindrop_list_highlights.label: List Highlights
raindrop_list_highlights.description: Lists highlights across all bookmarks or in one collection.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID from List Collections to list highlights of. Leave empty for highlights in all collections.

perpage.label: Per Page
perpage.description: Highlights per page, 1 to 50. Defaults to 25.

raindrop_update_highlight.label: Update Highlight
raindrop_update_highlight.description: Changes the text or color of a highlight on a bookmark.

raindropId.label: Bookmark ID
raindropId.description: ID of the bookmark the highlight is on: raindropRef from List Highlights.

raindrop_parse_url.label: Parse URL
raindrop_parse_url.description: Extracts title, excerpt, media and type from any URL without saving it.

raindrop_accept_invitation.label: Accept Invitation
raindrop_accept_invitation.description: Joins a shared collection using an invitation token.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: ID of the collection you were invited to, from the invitation email.

token.label: Invitation Token
token.description: Secret token from the invitation email link.

raindrop_list_collaborators.label: List Collaborators
raindrop_list_collaborators.description: Lists the people a collection is shared with.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.

raindrop_remove_collaborator.label: Remove Collaborator
raindrop_remove_collaborator.description: Removes a person from a shared collection.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.

userId.label: User ID
userId.description: Collaborator user ID, from List Collaborators.

raindrop_unshare_collection.label: Unshare Collection
raindrop_unshare_collection.description: Stops sharing a collection you own, or leaves a collection shared with you.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: ID of the shared collection, from List Collections.

raindrop_get_filters.label: Get Filters
raindrop_get_filters.description: Gets tag, type, favourite, broken and duplicate counts for a collection.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID from List Collections. Defaults to 0 (all bookmarks).

tagsSort.label: Sort Tags By
tagsSort.description: Order of the tags list. Defaults to count.

search.label: Search
search.description: Raindrop search query to count only matching bookmarks, e.g. "#reading" or "apple".

raindrop_list_tags.label: List Tags
raindrop_list_tags.description: Lists tags with the number of bookmarks using each.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID from List Collections to list tags of. Leave empty for tags in all collections.

raindrop_rename_tag.label: Rename Tag
raindrop_rename_tag.description: Renames a tag on every bookmark that has it.

tag.label: Tag
tag.description: Current tag name, exactly as returned by List Tags.

collectionId.label: Collection ID
collectionId.description: Collection ID from List Collections to limit the rename to. Leave empty to rename in all collections.

raindrop_get_current_user.label: Get Current User
raindrop_get_current_user.description: Gets the profile and settings of the connected account.

raindrop_get_user_by_name.label: Get User by Name
raindrop_get_user_by_name.description: Gets the public profile of a Raindrop.io user by username.

name.label: Username
name.description: The Raindrop.io username, as shown in the user's public profile URL.

raindrop_update_user.label: Update User
raindrop_update_user.description: Updates the connected account's name, email, settings or collection groups.

config.label: Settings
config.description: Settings keys to change, e.g. {"raindrops_sort": "-created", "raindrops_view": "grid", "lang": "en_US"}. Keys as returned in "config" by Get Current User.

groups.label: Collection Groups
groups.description: Full list of sidebar groups, replacing the current one, e.g. [{"title": "My Collections", "hidden": false, "sort": 0, "collections": [8364483, 8364403]}]. Collection IDs from List Collections.
